data.question: Regarding the recent surge in India's domestic sugar prices, what is the government's official stance on its relationship with the ethanol-blending programme?
options: The ethanol programme is the primary cause
The government officially denies any link between price spikes and ethanol diversion
Sugar prices are solely linked to export demand
Ethanol diversion is partially responsible
data.correct_answer: The government officially denies any link between price spikes and ethanol diversion

data.question: Which of the following environmental and agricultural factors significantly contributed to the recent shortfall in India's sugar production?
options: Extreme heatwave conditions in late spring
Excessive drought across North India
Outbreaks of Red Rot and Top Borer in major cane varieties
High soil alkalinity across Deccan states
data.correct_answer: Outbreaks of Red Rot and Top Borer in major cane varieties

data.question: What is the primary objective of the government's recent decision to impose stock limits on sugar dealers until November 30?
options: To encourage farmers to store their own harvest
To boost international trade margins
To reduce the tax burden on bulk manufacturers
To prevent hoarding and artificially created supply scarcity
data.correct_answer: To prevent hoarding and artificially created supply scarcity

data.question: Which factor distinguishes the National Population Register (NPR) from the decennial Census exercise?
options: The NPR focuses on 'usual residents' who live in an area for at least six months
The NPR excludes children under the age of eighteen
The NPR is mandatory for every person irrespective of residence
The NPR only counts citizens
data.correct_answer: The NPR focuses on 'usual residents' who live in an area for at least six months

data.question: Why has the inclusion of 'parental birth details' in the Census 2027 questionnaire sparked public debate?
options: Because these questions were previously linked to citizenship verification processes
Because it duplicates information already present in passports
Because the digital portal is prone to data leaks
Because such data is irrelevant to demographics
data.correct_answer: Because these questions were previously linked to citizenship verification processes

data.question: Political clearance from the Ministry of External Affairs is a mandatory requirement for which of the following groups when traveling abroad?
options: All government servants and public representatives
Only Ministers and Members of Parliament
Only high-ranking officials above the Joint Secretary level
Only officials visiting countries with poor diplomatic relations
data.correct_answer: All government servants and public representatives

data.question: In the context of the recent cancellation of a Chief Minister's US visit, what role does the Screening Committee of Secretaries (ScoS) play?
options: They handle the booking of diplomatic air travel
They grant initial financial grants
They manage the schedule of official foreign events
They review and approve foreign travel proposals for high-level officials
data.correct_answer: They review and approve foreign travel proposals for high-level officials

data.question: Which vaccine has been recently allocated to Congo by the WHO to combat the Ebola virus?
options: Ziviface
Ervebo
Covishield
Sputnik V
data.correct_answer: Ervebo

data.question: Ebola is primarily characterized by the medical term 'hemorrhagic fever' because it causes:
options: Rapid dehydration and kidney failure
Problems with the body's clotting system and internal bleeding
Neurological impairment and paralysis
Severe respiratory distress
data.correct_answer: Problems with the body's clotting system and internal bleeding

data.question: What is the primary goal of the National Animal Disease Control Programme (NADCP)?
options: To promote dairy exports globally
To mandate the use of artificial insemination
To eradicate Foot and Mouth Disease and Brucellosis
To increase the total headcount of non-bovine livestock
data.correct_answer: To eradicate Foot and Mouth Disease and Brucellosis

data.question: Brucellosis, a target disease of the NADCP, is notoriously difficult for farmers because it causes:
options: Stunted growth in all newborn calves
Fever and reproductive failure, leading to abortion
Respiratory blockage in adult cattle
Loss of appetite in aging buffaloes
data.correct_answer: Fever and reproductive failure, leading to abortion

data.question: What primary operational capability does the newly delivered INS Mangrol offer to the Indian Navy?
options: Global satellite signal reconnaissance
Airborne early warning and control
Anti-submarine warfare in shallow coastal waters
Long-range deep-sea ballistic defense
data.correct_answer: Anti-submarine warfare in shallow coastal waters

data.question: What makes INS Mangrol a notable milestone in India's naval defense journey?
options: It was gifted by a foreign maritime ally
It is the largest destroyer commissioned this year
It is the first submarine produced in India
It features over 80% indigenous design and content
data.correct_answer: It features over 80% indigenous design and content

data.question: Which of the following best describes the 'modal price' of a commodity?
options: The average of the highest and lowest recorded prices
The price regulated by government legislation
The cost of production plus a fixed profit margin
The price at which most transactions occur in a market
data.correct_answer: The price at which most transactions occur in a market

data.question: The National Population Register update was controversial in 2020 primarily because:
options: It was only applicable to rural population sectors
Many perceived it as a potential precursor to citizenship verification exercises
The data collection was outsourced to a foreign firm
It did not include digital literacy data
data.correct_answer: Many perceived it as a potential precursor to citizenship verification exercises

data.question: Which body oversees the approval of foreign trips for Members of the Lok Sabha?
options: Department of Personnel and Training
Ministry of External Affairs
The Speaker of the Lok Sabha
Prime Minister's Office
data.correct_answer: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha

data.question: How does the 'recombinant' nature of the Ervebo vaccine aid in its safety profile?
options: It uses the entire deactivated Ebola virus
It relies on plant-based biological triggers
It only utilizes a single protein from the virus, making the disease impossible
It requires multiple doses to reach full effectiveness
data.correct_answer: It only utilizes a single protein from the virus, making the disease impossible

data.question: Cloven-hoofed animals, the primary target of Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD), include:
options: Only cattle and buffaloes
Only ruminants with single-chambered stomachs
Horses, donkeys, and mules
Cattle, buffaloes, sheep, goats, and pigs
data.correct_answer: Cattle, buffaloes, sheep, goats, and pigs

data.question: In the current economic context of the sugar industry, what does the 'closing stock' indicate?
options: Estimated leftover sugar supply at the end of the season
The quantity of sugar wasted due to spoilage
The amount of sugar kept for exports
Total sugar sold during the year
data.correct_answer: Estimated leftover sugar supply at the end of the season

data.question: Which feature of the ASW SWC ships ensures their effectiveness in tracking submarines?
options: Lightweight torpedoes and shallow-water sonars
Integration with long-range aircraft
High-altitude radar arrays
Ability to stay submerged for 30 days
data.correct_answer: Lightweight torpedoes and shallow-water sonars
